linkageRateNote: Proportion of commits touching Java files that carry at least one Jira issue key. Values below 0.20 indicate poor traceability and reduced label reliability.

snoring.policy: Rows are emitted only for the oldest release window; the full timeline is still used for labels.

labeling.notes: The oracle uses affected versions when available. When absent, the injected version is predicted via the Proportion algorithm (mean P=0,9805). When no calibration data exists, P defaults to 1.0 (IV=OV).

kappaNote: Cohen's Kappa is a classifier-evaluation metric and is not computed during Milestone 1 dataset extraction.
